affected_subject.reason: Identifies RiskEngine.twapEMA() and its incorrect tuple unpacking of OraclePack.getEMAs().

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete positional tuple assignment in twapEMA() maps eonsEMA<-spotEMA, slowEMA<-fastEMA, fastEMA<-slowEMA.

direct_effect.reason: Computes (6*slow+3*fast+spot)/10 instead of intended 0.6*fast+0.3*slow+0.1*eons, feeding wrong twapTick into dispatch, solvency, and liquidation pricing.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected-vs-actual TWAP formula mismatch and internal inconsistency with isSafeMode()'s correct unpacking establish a numeric/consistency safety relation.

summary: Report identifies the affected function, the concrete mis-unpacking trigger, the resulting wrong TWAP value and its downstream consumption, and an expected-vs-actual formula relation confirmed by isSafeMode()'s correct ordering.
